baselineAudit.notes: Static triage only. 80/244 items in the third rewrite tranche are classified for substantive revision and qualified educator review; no clinical approval or content changes were recorded.

commonFindings: All 20 items repeat the generic reassessment stem and four reusable answer/rationale families; all are single-response and do not demonstrate the planned NGN format diversity.
Named respiratory/airway and endocrine topics are not supported by topic-defining history, focused assessment, diagnostic data or timeline.
Several patient contexts are incompatible with the named topic (e.g., newborn total laryngectomy, newborn DKA) or omit required device/procedure context (chest tube, tracheostomy, NIV, ventilator).
Unrelated acute findings such as hyperkalemia, hypoglycemia, hyponatremia/seizure, INR/hematuria and anemia create competing priorities unrelated to the assigned topic.
Generic options and boilerplate rationales test broad escalation/effectiveness rather than a distinct, defensible topic-specific nursing decision.
